# Imported Sprinkles source and assets

Source: doceazedo/sprinkles, revision
`0e978f5a9afc6b456b3693c8761e73a6c7e155bd`.
The upstream README is retained as `README.upstream.md`.

The imported runtime/editor code is used under its MIT option; `LICENSE-MIT`
and the alternative `LICENSE-APACHE` are retained. Theia ports Bevy APIs and
extracts the editor as a library; it does not claim upstream authorship.

Asset notices from the pinned upstream README and source:

- Preset particle textures are by Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack,
  under CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.
- Bundled project examples and textures are CC0, as declared in upstream README.
- `ri-*.png` icons are Remix Icon by Remix Design; `LICENSE-REMIX-ICON` is retained.
- `blender-*.png` icons are by Andrzej Ambroż under CC BY-SA 4.0:
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/.
  These icon PNGs are copied unchanged. Upstream attribution source:
  https://devtalk.blender.org/t/license-for-blender-icons/5522/21.
- The upstream donut icon is an edited Noto Emoji icon under Apache 2.0;
  https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji/blob/main/svg/LICENSE.
- Inter Variable is under SIL OFL 1.1; `LICENSE-INTER-OFL.txt` is retained.

The code licenses do not replace the separate asset licenses above. Original
asset filenames are preserved. Engine/API adaptations and host integration are
Theia changes; the source-file manifest records original and imported hashes.
